data.note: Self-drive no-licence boat from Cavtat (~EUR85/half-day for 4, 2026 price — was EUR60). Book ahead; calm Konavle coast/islets, ~500m-from-shore zone. Lead water activity of the relaxed D12.
Redundant — Restaurant Or'O is the D8 special refuel. Keep as a Black Lake terrace option.
BOOK: Mid-afternoon arrival ~15:45-16:00 is fine and even ideal: it's a SWIM stop, so the peak heat is welcom…
NOT on the fly-out day — no flying within 18-24h of diving (decompression risk). Keep as a dive option for a non-flying day only.
Waterfront Kotor-bay camp (Donji Stoliv), hot showers, ~EUR30-40 for 4. Kotor old town ~12min by car / water-taxi for nightlife (taxi back).
FLIGHT 20:40 (check-in closes ~20:00, car drop ~19:15). Jun 28 is a cruise day (Explorer of the Seas in port) — Old Town->Cilipi runs 45-60min, NOT 25. LEAVE the Old Town by ~18:00.
PLAN B: buy the ferry ticket ONLINE beforehand. If not clearing arrivals by ~17:50, SKIP the 20:30 - sleep mainland (Autocamp Prapratno, near Ston) + take the 10:15 ferry D4 AM.
Closed Sundays (Jun 28) — Barba is the quick Dubrovnik seafood pick. Option for a non-Sunday.
Emerald glacial lake ~16km up from Konjic, on the Jablanica→Sarajevo line — SELF-RENT a SUP/kayak (not just a swim) for the morning reset. Replaces the wrong-way Diva Grabovica/Drežnica detour.

THE Mljet highlight — self-rent kayak/SUP across the emerald salt lakes to St Mary islet. Book the night before for ~08:30; NP entry ~EUR25pp. Then drive to Sobra for the 12:00 (or 16:00) ferry off. Activity > sit-down food: grab quick / cook at camp.
Quick dawn cliff-jump/swim ~1.3km from camp (~07:30) before driving W to the kayak — skippable for a slower start. Free, no ticket.
Quick food or cook at camp is the default — don't lose kayak/swim time to a sit-down dinner. Han stays as the OPTION for one nice Herzegovina meal if the group wants it.
Lamb ispod saca + Piva-lake terrace in Pluzine - D7 dinner near the Boricje bed.
Optional/weather-dependent — group chose Krka as the D1 anchor. Only if you book ahead + the morning is clear; no next-day rebook (you drive south D2).
Relaxed Kotor old-town bar night (Bokun, Letrika, Bandiera) — no dress code, walkable, ~10-15min taxi/water-taxi back to Stoliv camp.

BOOK: ~10:00-11:30 — early enough to walk before peak heat and before tour-bus crowds build; gates open 08:00…
BOOK: ~18:00 (late-afternoon/sunset tasting — Vranac & KratoSija with ham, cheese, garden veg; cooler, vineya…
Fills the airport dead-window: swim/snorkel the Rat peninsula ~15:45-16:45, then 10min to Dubrovnik airport for the 17:20 friend pickup. Beats sitting at the gate.

All-day self-rent SUP on Skadar from Virpazar (paired with the winery in the same village) — the big self-rent water activity D10 was missing. Virpazar cluster; do this OR the far-south Murići push if you'd rather not drive.
BOOK: Book the ~06:30 or 07:00 car entry — first slots = cool, clear, haze-free summit views and you descend …
Legal Krka swim — boat down to Skradin from the falls (swimming in Skradinski Buk is BANNED), village beach 5min from the port. Turns the Krka boardwalk into walk+swim, zero detour.
Self-rent kayak on the emerald Neretva, right at the Ravna/Jablanica overnight — evening paddle that fills the arrival slack with zero extra driving.
Secret sandy swim cove below Godinje, ~5min off the Virpazar leg — warm-water swim, near-zero detour.
The ONE Riviera peka (the day's special meal) — best-rated Brela konoba, 10m from the beach, no Omiš backtrack. Pre-order octopus/veal peka in the morning. Replaces Konoba Gušti.
BOOK: Late afternoon ~16:15-17:30 — heat-tolerant, fits after Mostar town, and well within the 21:00 close. R…
BOOK: Arrive ~19:00 with daylight to pitch tents; confirm with the host that arrival after ~18:00 is OK (call…
Generic konoba (rated 3) + Omiš backtrack + peka needs 3-6h pre-order — replaced by Konoba Feral (Brela). Option only if you pre-order peka that morning.
Inland 77km detour; swimming BANNED since 2021 (walk/photo only). Go early (gate 08:00) or skip if doing the skydive - can't do both well on arrival day.
Sundays quiet/closed - D6 is a Sunday. Use the Bascarsija bar cluster tonight instead.
D2 water anchor (swapped in for rafting): 12m jumps, 55m waterfall rappel, slides, swim-throughs; wetsuits provided. Book ahead, morning slot. Rafting kept as the skip-if-tired option.
Night-arrival-safe Mljet camp by the Sobra ferry (pool, restaurant, mini-market) - pitch within minutes of the 20:30 ferry landing ~21:15. (Autokamp Marina/Ropa kept as the NP-side alternative.)
Iconic WWII sunken railway bridge + Battle of Neretva museum, right on the M-17 as you leave Ravna/Jablanica - quick on-route stop.
Do Mostar FIRST (~08:00-09:00) - Stari Most is empty + cool then; midday = mobbed + 35C.
SPECIAL meal: grilled Buna-spring trout on a terrace over Europe's largest karst spring — the meal IS the stop, at the Blagaj Tekija visit. (Tima-Irma ćevapi stays as the quick option.)
Free swim-canyon (Stupina jump pool) directly on the M17 north between Mostar and the Ravna camp — zero backtrack, slots into the afternoon drive.
Self-rent kayak/SUP on turquoise Piva Lake (Beach Bar Hook, Plužine) — the lakefront IS the overnight, so it fills the light recovery afternoon with self-rent water, not a passive swim.

Lead with the EUR20 boat-taxi to Beska island (monasteries) + swim off the boat — the open-water swim-across is deceptively long/no lifeguard, so boat-taxi is the default, swim only for strong swimmers. Far south shore (~1.5h drive); do this OR the Virpazar SUP cluster.
Do it FIRST at the bridge (~09:00-09:30, before peak crowds) via the Mostari club + their mandatory training jump. ~24m - real commitment, decide on the day.
BOOK: Optional LATE night ~23:00-02:00, only if the group skips a hard early-active day. Note it precedes the…
BOOK: ~11:45 as an early lunch right after the walls — beats the midday restaurant crowd and pairs naturally …
BOOK: Be parked by ~17:10; expect to actually roll out ~17:45-18:00. Leave Pelješac by ~15:45 to absorb June …
D12 is a camp-cook night at Camping Kate — keep this farm konoba as the option if you want one Konavle sit-down.
Fortress climb (1350 steps) start ~17:00 - cooler + good light; booth/walls close ~20:00 (go to first rampart for the 20:26 sunset).
Steep cliff stair/tunnel descent (~250m) - proper shoes, go early AM right after the Vitaljina border (not midday), limited roadside parking.
Late dress-up club option (smart-casual dress code) — only if you want a proper club night.
~80min round-trip spur E to the Djurdjevica bridge — cut from D8 after the Prutas summit; do only if the morning was light.
Post-summit recovery swim under the Durmitor peaks (~15min SE of Žabljak) — the low-effort 'swim under the mountains' moment after the Prutaš grind. Protects rest, still an activity.
Easy warm river swim at Danilo's Bridge in the same village as the kayak + Mostina — fills the post-paddle gap, zero driving.
Merged into the self-rent kayak (which paddles to Karučko Oko) — no double-count. Still reachable by the paddle.
Book GO2FLY ahead; they fly when conditions suit (AM often smoother, late-PM better light). Do it while in the Budva area before heading N to Kotor.
Sunday-safe Sarajevo night out - Kino Bosna is quiet/closed on Sundays.
If paddling late-day, stay on the sheltered Crnojevic river bend (not open lake) - afternoon wind. DEET at dusk.

Trailhead 06:00-06:30; off the ridge by noon (June PM storms). NOTE: upper ridge is exposed/scrambly (UIAA-I, some cables) — not for the exposure-averse; Planinica (me-planinica) is the non-technical big-view alternative. Pick one summit only.

Cliff-jumping/swim off the 'Hawaii' ledges ~13:00-15:00 (boat shuttle ~EUR5-7 from Budva) — scout each ledge for depth before jumping. Keep it early-afternoon so the late afternoon stays free for the Kotor fortress sunset climb.
Early swim/snorkel 5min from the Old Town before the 10:00 kayak — fills the otherwise-dead 08:00-10:00 morning. Quiet local beach, great Old-Town view.
45-60min is plenty (group is lukewarm on monasteries) — quick visit on the morning drive, keep the day's time for the Skadar water.
Bikes are a dead item after a 6h summit — the Vražje jezero recovery swim replaces it. Option for anyone who skips the summit.
BOOK: 10:00 morning departure — back ~13:00, leaves the whole afternoon as buffer before the 19:15 car drop a…
BOOK: Morning slot — arrive ~10:15–10:30 for the 11:30 launch, off the water by ~14:00. Keeps the whole Piva …
